descriptions.w3d_list_name_greater_8010e698: Compares two pointed-to strings and returns whether the first sorts after the second.
descriptions.w3d_list_service_construct_8010e6d0: Constructs the selection-list service and clears nineteen held list objects.
descriptions.w3d_list_service_destroy_8010e75c: Releases nineteen held list objects in reverse order and destroys the base service.
descriptions.w3d_list_service_dispatch_8010e9b4: Routes list-selection messages to the requested list builder and forwards to the base service.
